definitions.explanation: The act of administering a vaccine to a person or animal to build immunity against a disease.

examples.japanese: ワクチンを{接種|せっしゅ}する。
インフルエンザの{予防|よぼう}{接種|せっしゅ}を{受|う}けた。
{三回目|さんかいめ}の{接種|せっしゅ}は、{二回目|にかいめ}から{少|すく}なくとも{三|さん}ヶ{月|げつ}{空|あ}けてください。
examples.english: Please wait at least three months after the second dose before getting the third vaccination.

notes:
A medical/public health term for vaccination or inoculation. Became extremely common in everyday Japanese during the COVID-19 pandemic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予防|よぼう}{接種|せっしゅ}: preventive vaccination
- ワクチン{接種|せっしゅ}: vaccine inoculation
- {接種|せっしゅ}を{受|う}ける: to receive a vaccination
- {接種|せっしゅ}{券|けん}: vaccination voucher/ticket
- {接種|せっしゅ}{会場|かいじょう}: vaccination site
- {追加|ついか}{接種|せっしゅ}: booster shot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {摂取|せっしゅ}: intake, consumption — a homophone with a completely different meaning (taking in food/nutrients)
- {注射|ちゅうしゃ}: injection — a broader term for any injection, not limited to vaccines
- {予防|よぼう}: prevention — the general concept; {予防|よぼう}{接種|せっしゅ} specifically means preventive vaccination
